title: Robert Fagel (The Hague) to Prince William V, 18 June 1804 (KHA A31 PWV inv. 337; DECODE R2238)

documents.shelfmark: Koninklijk Huisarchief, The Hague, A31 Prins Willem V, inv. nr. 337; DECODE R2238

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the DECODE images or record; none found in print.

transcription.source: DECODE images IMG_R2238_I15526_P3 (full resolution, deskewed line crops)
transcription.notes: 128 figure groups counted by regex after removing clear words and superscript marks; _check_profile --measure --digits gives 101 comma-separated words (dot-joined groups counted as one). Superscript marks (c, 3, 6, 9, fractions) uncertain.

system.summary: Numerical code of 2-4 digit groups up to 2510, commas between words and dots joining groups within a word, clear endings (t, e, s) appended to some groups, embedded in a clear French letter.
system.notes: Keys tested and ruled out: the Stadholder's Grand Chiffre of 1782 (DECODE R1024, Euler) plain and with every start of its additive Tableau; the 1790s Orange name key R2240; Dutch codebooks R1035 (1803) and R1891 (1798). Siblings R2236/R2237/R2239 in the same inv. nr. use a different small-number system.

prior_solution.where: DECODE status non-decrypted; no decipherment on the letter

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code with Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.
tools: DECODE API and filesrv image download
key lookup and Tableau start-point brute force (python)

solution.what: Fetched DECODE R2238 record and its three page images with the session cookie; page 3 carries the cipher, pages 2 and 1 are clear.
Transcribed the cipher passage (128 groups, one interlinear insertion) and the clear context.
Grand Chiffre du Stadhouder (R1024, 1782) via the DECODE key transcription, direct lookup.
Grand Chiffre with the additive Tableau (11 rows x 17 values) from every row and column start, scored on syllable fit of dot-joined groups.
R2240 Orange key (letters 1-100, names 100-6006); R1035 and R1891 Dutch codebooks; siblings R2236, R2237, R2239 in the same inventory number.

outcome.notes: Key not located. The code (about 2500 groups) is too large for 128 groups of text without the key; next step is the KHA's William V / Fagel papers for a code book of 1801-1806.
